lines.zh: 所谓{i}极不愿意{/i}，指的是她整晚都坚决不肯从我身上下去。

lines.en: But I guess there will always be a next time.
lines.zh: 不过我想，总会有下一次的。

lines.en: Or at least I hope there will be.
lines.zh: 至少我希望会有。

lines.en: This would be a horrible thing to only experience once.
lines.zh: 这种事要是只经历一次，那可太惨了。

lines.en: I walk into my bedroom with a grin (Or at least something close to it) on my face and a fire in my heart.
lines.zh: 我走进自己的卧室，脸上挂着笑容（或者至少是接近笑容的东西），心里燃着一团火。

lines.en: Tonight, I deflowered a girl and then proceeded to have a threesome with her mother and a close friend of mine shortly after.
lines.zh: 今晚，我夺走了一个女孩的初夜，随后不久又和她的母亲以及我的一位密友来了场三人行。

lines.en: This might just be the greatest night of my life.
lines.zh: 这大概就是我人生中最棒的一夜。

lines.en: I collapse onto the bed with less energy than ever before.
lines.zh: 我倒在床上，精疲力竭到了前所未有的程度。

lines.en: Ami still isn’t home, so I imagine the party is still going.
lines.zh: Ami 还没回来，所以我想派对还在继续。

lines.en: I think about heading over there to see how things are but, at this rate, I don’t even know if I’d have enough energy to get out of bed.
lines.zh: 我想过去看看情况，可按我现在的状态，我甚至不知道自己还有没有力气爬下床。
所以——

lines.en: Without anything else left to do-
lines.zh: 再没别的事可做——

lines.en: I close out this glorious holiday weekend the same way I close out {i}every{/i} weekend.
lines.zh: 我用和{i}每个{/i}周末一样的方式，为这个辉煌的假日周末画上句号。

lines.en: By closing my eyes and waiting for the next day to come.
lines.zh: 闭上眼睛，等待第二天的到来。

lines.en: : I wonder if Maya is able to reset the world to Halloween again next time?
lines.zh: : 我在想，Maya 下次能不能把世界重置回万圣节？

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You have completed the first ever Halloween update for Lessons in Love!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你已完成《Lessons in Love》的首个万圣节更新！{/i}
{i}圣诞节就在眼前了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}How crazy would it be if there were an event for that next?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}要是下一个活动就是关于它的，那得有多疯狂？{/i}
{i}Haruka 的欲望提升到了 [haruka_lust]!{/i}
